profile_text.body:
AppLovin describes itself as an advertising platform built for growth, saying it reaches over a billion daily users in mobile games and helps consumer brands and gaming apps scale their business profitably. It says every ad runs fullscreen during natural pauses in the game experience or is chosen in exchange for rewards, rather than being scrolled past or swiped away in a feed. The site names consumer brands, gaming apps, and agencies as its audiences and points visitors to a dashboard, a Shopify app, a pixel helper, and a strategy call.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, trading under the ticker APP, with CIK 0001751008. It is also listed as APPLOVIN CORP-CLASS A. No products or MCP servers are tracked for it.

Litigation exposure is recorded in California, with 281 cases listed.
